init_spark_configs: initialize Spark standalone cluster configs with optional aggressive mode and IPv4 preference for a given platform
get_hardware_info: get the hardware info dict including cores, memory, arch, and sockets for a specified platform
get_standalone_cli_args: get the Spark standalone CLI arguments dict for a specified platform including master URL and memory settings
get_standalone_configs: get the full Spark standalone configuration dict for a specified platform including executor and JVM options
check_platform: validate that a given platform string is one of the supported platforms before use
